pages.title: Immune Memory
pages.text: $(thing)Immune Memory$()$(br2)Memory cells that outlive the fight and answer at once the next time, for years. Unlocks lasting Wards, held safe for good.

$(thing)Insight$(): 180$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Immunisation, Directed Evolution.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Fracture Ward, 1 Telomerase Complex.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Memory falls off slowly, by a half-life T. Write the share S still protected after a time t.
